github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Commit messages MUST follow Conventional Commits (enforced by commitlint @commitlint/config-conventional): format '<type>(<optional-scope>): <subject>'. type must be one of: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert. Subject: English, imperative mood, must NOT start with an uppercase letter, no trailing period. Keep the header under 100 characters. Example: 'docs: finalize full-mvp database design and update sprint plans'.
